name: Strudel Dough
summary: Stretched translucent by hand. Almost no fat in the dough.

steps.text: Knead hard for ten minutes until glossy and very elastic.
Rest under oil for one hour minimum.
Stretch over a floured cloth until you can read through it.
Brush with butter, fill, and roll using the cloth.

bake.notes: Brush with butter between every roll for separate layers.

notes: The long rest is what lets it stretch without tearing.
